signals.name: Monitor status since DTCs cleared
signals.description: [CONFIRMED_LIVE] Diagnostics readiness and DTC/MIL status. Useful as a baseline diagnostic status value. Confirmed live in the Peugeot 107 raw Pelican report with 4 positive samples.

signals.name: Fuel system status 1
